scope: The joined Govett-Brewster Art Gallery and Len Lye Centre in New Plymouth in July 2020, including the cream former theatre facade with its canopy and the curved stainless-steel street fronts of the extension.

originalReview.notes: The original street view shows the old cream facade, high pilasters, entrance awning and glass doors, and the adjoining silver columns with a vertically stepped parapet.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact first-party Qualla CC0 exterior. Author Tom Ackroyd is identified in the current native revision under the original uploader account Quilt Phase.
